title: Ways differ, no common scheme.
next_chapter_hook: As Chen Ji was shocked by the word "fusion," an ultimate gaze beyond Heavenly Dao pierced through the void—the true Chess Player was finally about to take this pair of destiny twins onto the chessboard.

text.content:
Chen Xuan's words "The Eye of Heavenly Dao is merely a puppet of a higher existence" hit like a basin of ice water. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, his fingertips unconsciously tightening. He thought he had seen the truth of the Tianji Record thoroughly enough, yet he never expected this was merely the tip of the iceberg.

"What are you saying?" Chen Ji's voice was extremely low, yet it couldn't hide the tremor within. He stared fixedly at Chen Xuan's eyes, identical to his own, trying to read more information from them.

In the void, two figures stood in confrontation. The surrounding threads of destiny seemed to sense this unusual tension, stopping their aimless drifting and hanging down in unison.

dialogue.content: "What do you think the Tianji Record is?" Chen Xuan sneered, "It's the Eye of Heavenly Dao, born specifically to observe destiny. And the Eye of Heavenly Dao is merely the surveillance placed in all realms by that higher existence—the Chess Player you thought you were, has been a chess piece from start to finish."
"Then who is the true Chess Player?" Chen Ji's voice was like an ice blade tempered with poison.

text.content:
Chen Xuan didn't answer directly. He stood with hands clasped behind his back, bearingproudly, resembling an immortal gazing down at ants.

"What meaning does knowing this have for you?" His tone was casual, "You're merely a puppet chosen by the Tianji Record, just like me. Instead of questioning matters beyond the chessboard, consider how to survive longer in this game."

Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, suppressing the surging shock deep in his heart. When he opened them again, his gaze had become crystal clear.

"You're wrong." His voice was terrifyingly calm, "The Tianji Record is not a shackle—it is a blade in my hand. Since you claim the Eye of Heavenly Dao is merely a puppet, I'll show you today whether this blade can wound the Chess Player."

dialogue.content: "You want to prove the possibility of breaking the game?" Chen Xuan's interest was piqued, "Fine, let's see what capital you have."

text.content:
Chen Ji spoke no more. He formed a seal with one hand, and a complex golden rune appeared at his Brow Center. In the next instant, an ancient scroll rose slowly from the crown of his head, hovering in mid-air.

The scroll flowed with mysterious patterns, golden light blazing forth in myriad rays, as if carrying the will of Heavenly Dao. On the cover, three ancient seal characters gleamed brilliantly—Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: "Is this your trump card?" Chen Xuan narrowed his eyes, "A mutilated Tianji Record, four fragments—how do you propose to fight me?"
"Four pages are enough." Chen Ji sneered coldly, "Watch closely—this is the possibility of breaking the game!"

text.content:
As the words fell, Chen Ji pressed his palm heavily onto the Tianji Record. Spiritual Energy rushed in frantically, golden light blazing ten thousand times brighter, illuminating the entire sky.

In that instant, the entire void seemed to be reshuffled. Countless threads of destiny emerged from the void, weaving into an enormous net of cause and effect. And deep within the net, thirty-two points of light flickered faintly, representing thirty-six possible branching futures.

Chen Xuan's pupils contracted sharply.

"This is... the Quasi-Tianji realm?" For the first time, his voice carried a tremor, "How is this possible—the Tianji Record can only see a single scene three hours ahead, right? How can it show so many branches?"

dialogue.content: "Because you fundamentally misunderstand the Tianji Record." Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, robes billowing, "This is its true purpose—not to prophecy outcomes, but to display choices."

text.content:
He pointed, and the thirty-six points of light instantly expanded, each extending countless threads of cause and effect, pointing toward entirely different futures.

"See this? Along this branch, three hours from now, an Outer Disciple of the Tianqing Sect will die in a demonic cultivator's attack. And I only need to draw here lightly—"

Chen Ji's fingertip lightly plucked that thread of destiny.

In an instant, that thread originally pointing toward death snapped abruptly, replaced by a new path—the Outer Disciple not only survived but also became an Inner Disciple three months later.

And the price for all this was Chen Ji losing five points of Heavenly Fate.

dialogue.content: "Trivial trick." Chen Xuan snorted coldly, though there was no more contempt in his eyes than before, "The life and death of one Outer Disciple—what impact does it have on the entire chess game? Merely a drop in the ocean."
"Can't you see it yet?" Chen Ji laughed, his smile carrying a hint of mockery, "This is the true power of the Tianji Record—it isn't meant to predict destiny, but to rewrite it."

choice.prompt: Chen Xuan's challenge was pointed—if altering one person was effortless, what about shaking the entire chessboard? How should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Prove it with a greater price
choices.description: Rewrite an important line of destiny on the spot, letting Chen Xuan witness the core power of the Tianji Record firsthand, regardless of losing more Heavenly Fate.
choices.visible_reward: Prove to Chen Xuan that breaking the game is truly possible
choices.risk_hint: Massive consumption of Heavenly Fate may lead to crisis later

text.content: "Fine, then let me show you everything!" Chen Ji vigorously urged the Tianji Record, golden light blazing to its extreme. What he was about to rewrite was a line concerning the fate of the Tianqing Sect.

dialogue.content: Watch carefully—this line marks the turning point of the three great sects' hundred-year fate!

choices.description: No consumption of Heavenly Fate. Instead, dismantle Chen Jie's arguments with words—pointing out that the 'chessboard' itself can be broken, the key is finding loopholes in the rules.
choices.risk_hint: Chen Jie might counter back with logic

text.content: "Shake the chessboard?" Chen Ji laughed lightly, "What do you think the chessboard is? It's merely a collection of rules. And the rule-makers can never create perfect, flawless rules."

dialogue.content: "Prophets are the greatest loophole in the rules."

choices.description: Counter-question Chen Jie—if the Heavenly Eye is so powerful, why do you still need to waste words with me here? Did you also see facts you have to admit?
choices.visible_reward: Force Chen Jie to reveal flaws
choices.risk_hint: Might expose some of one's own trump cards

text.content: Chen Ji didn't continue the argument, but suddenly shifted topics, his smile turning playful: "You keep saying the Heavenly Eye controls everything, so let me ask you one thing—"

dialogue.content: "Since the Heavenly Eye is so powerful, capable of controlling everyone's fate, why do you still need to stand here wasting words with me?"

text.content:
Chen Jie fell silent.

The pride in those golden eyes wavered slightly, as if Chen Ji had hit upon something. He didn't immediately counter, but静静地看着陈机，像是在重新scrutinizing一件出乎意料的珍宝。
"Interesting." Chen Jie finally spoke, his tone becoming profound, "You're closer to the truth than I imagined. But precisely because of that—"

dialogue.content: "You should understand even more—there's never been a true winner in this game."

"That may not be the case." Chen Ji put away the Tianji Record, his eyes blazing with light, "The chessboard is dead, but people are alive. As long as there are people unwilling to be chess pieces, this game will always have the possibility of being overturned."

text.content:
Chen Jie looked at Chen Ji, his gaze complex beyond measure. After a long while, he suddenly burst into laughter, yet within that laughter was an inexplicable emotion.

"'Overturn the chessboard,' what a phrase!" His laughter stopped abruptly, his gaze sharp as a blade, "But have you ever considered—"

dialogue.content: "After overturning the chessboard, what do you plan to do? Establish a new chessboard and continue being the new Chess Player? Or—"
Chen Jie stepped forward, closing the distance between them until their noses nearly touched. His voice dropped to a low,诡异tempting：
"Have you ever considered—perhaps we were never enemies from the start?"

text.content:
These words were like thunder, exploding in Chen Ji's mind.

His pupils constricted sharply, and looking at this face identical to his own, an unprecedented sense of absurdity surged through his heart.

choice.prompt: Chen Jie's words were profound—what does 'not enemies' mean? How should Chen Ji respond to this psychological game?

choices.description: Don't be swayed by Chen Jie's words; deconstruct his intentions logically—if he said this, there must be a purpose. There is no such thing as kindness without reason in this world.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain Rationality, Assess the Situation Clearly

text.content: Chen Ji didn't respond immediately; instead, he stepped back, creating distance from Chen Jie. His eyes flickered as he quickly deduced the intention behind Chen Jie's words.

dialogue.content: "What are you scheming?"

choices.description: Since you claim you're not an enemy, what exactly do you want? Speak plainly, don't hide anything.
choices.visible_reward: Force Chen Jie to Reveal His Hand
choices.risk_hint: May Fall Right into Chen Jie's Trap

text.content: "Not an enemy?" Chen Ji sneered coldly, "Then tell me, what exactly do you want?"

dialogue.content: "Since we're both pawns of the Tianji Record, between us, it's either you die or I die—is there any third possibility?"

choices.description: Pretend to be swayed, lower Chen Jie's guard, see what tricks he's playing. Meanwhile, secretly prepare your defenses.

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered slightly, a thoughtful expression crossing his face. He didn't refute, but followed Chen Jie's words:

dialogue.content: "...Continue."

text.content: Chen Jie observed Chen Ji's reaction, a meaningful smile slowly curling at the corner of his mouth.\n\nAs if making a decision, he waved his hand, and a massive screen suddenly appeared in the void. Countless images flowed across the screen, each frame a fragment of a prophecy.

"Do you know why the Tianji Record chose both of us?" Chen Jie's voice was low and penetrating, "One is the acknowledgedtrash, the other is the heavens' favorite—such vastly different people, yet both bear the power of the Tianji Record."

dialogue.content: "Because we are twins." Chen Jie turned, his golden eyes fixed directly on Chen Ji, "Born at the same hour, bound by the same fate—the Tianji Record chose us, not because of either one of us, but because—"
He paused, his voice suddenly rising:
—Fusion!

text.content: These two words exploded like thunder in Chen Ji's mind. He stared at Chen Jie, pupils constricting sharply. An indescribable tremor rose from the depths of his heart, nearly stealing his breath. "What did you say?"

dialogue.content: "Twin Fates, one body with two aspects." Chen Jie's voice seemed to descend from the highest heavens, "You represent the possibility of breaking the pattern, while I represent fate's steadfast guardian—separately, we are merely the two ends of a scale, forever unable to break equilibrium."

"But what if we fuse?" He spread his arms wide, as if embracing heaven and earth, "Breaking the pattern and fate merged into one, the prophet and the prophesied unified—when that time comes, we shall no longer be pieces, but new Chess Players!"

text.content: Chen Ji stood frozen, momentarily unsure how to react. Chen Jie's words were too shocking, exceeding all his expectations. Was this truth, or another trap?

choice.prompt: Chen Jie had thrown out this shocking proposal of 'Fusion'—was this the only path to breaking the pattern, or another meticulously designed trap? Chen Ji had to make a choice.

choices.description: Regardless of whether Chen Jie spoke truth or falsehood, fusion meant losing oneself. No one could guarantee that 'Chen Ji' would still exist after fusion.
choices.risk_hint: Might miss the true method to break the pattern

text.content: "Enough!" Chen Ji abruptly cut off Chen Jie, cold light blazing in his eyes, "Whether what you say is true or false, I will not agree."

dialogue.content: "I am me, not anyone's subordinate. Fusion? Hmph, you think I would abandon my personality for the sake of so-called power?"

choices.description: Not immediately refuse, but not easily believe either. Make Chen Jie provide proof that fusion can truly break the chess game, not that it's a scheme to devour him.

text.content: Chen Ji didn't immediately refute, but asked in a low voice: "You say fusion can break the chess game—where's the proof?"

dialogue.content: "Why should I believe you? What if this is just another trap?"

choices.description: Pretend to be tempted, lure Chen Jie into revealing more details. If fusion truly works, then Chen Jie must know more secrets about the Tianji Record.

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered, a contemplative expression crossing his face. After a moment, he spoke slowly:

dialogue.content: "'...If the merging is truly feasible, then after the merging, what will 'we' become?'

text.content:
Just then, an invisible pressure suddenly descended from the depths of the heavens.

Chen Ji's expression instantly changed drastically. He abruptly looked up, only to see a massive eye emerging from the void—the eye was completely black, fathomless, as if containing endless void and destruction.

Heavenly Providence's Eye.

But unlike before, at this moment the Heavenly Providence's Eye was no longer merely a cold projection of will. Within its depths, a vague figure emerged—the figure was so towering that one glimpse would spark despair.

"Interesting." A voice emanated from that figure, aged and majestic, as if carrying the weight of countless epochs, "Two chess pieces, actually discussing overturning the board?'

Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill surge from his spine to the crown of his head.

He had seen this eye countless times, but never had it made him feel such intense suffocation. What was even more terrifying was that the pressure emanating from that vague figure was ten thousand times more fearsome than the Heavenly Providence's Eye itself.

dialogue.content: Chen Jie's expression also shifted slightly, but quickly regained composure. He lifted his gaze to directly confront that massive eye, even a cold smirk tugging at the corner of his lips:
"Does the puppet have temper now? Or has the chess master lost patience?"

text.content:
A cold harrumph echoed through the void, yet the vague figure seemed unprovoked, instead letting out a low chuckle:

"Chen Jie, you've been drowning in the Heavenly Providence's Eye for too long, you've forgotten your identity." The voice was placid yet carried undeniable authority, "You think merging can free you from this chess game? How laughable—"

"Both of you, from the moment you were born, have been pieces I positioned on the board.'

This statement struck Chen Ji's heart like a sledgehammer.

He stared intently at the vague figure, countless thoughts flashing through his mind like lightning. The chess master... the true chess master... so from the very beginning, both he and Chen Jie were merely tools in another's hand.

But strangely, Chen Ji did not feel despair.

Instead, an unprecedented fighting spirit rose from the depths of his heart. He slowly raised his head, directly facing that massive eye containing the Heavenly Providence's Eye, his eyes blazing with brilliance.

dialogue.content: "Chess pieces?" Chen Ji laughed, the smile carrying a hint of mockery, "I must ask—if we were your pieces from the start, why reveal all this to us?'
"Since you can control destiny, why go through all this trouble? Unless—" he paused, his gaze suddenly sharpening, "—unless even you don't know how this ends.'

text.content:
The void suddenly fell silent.

That vague figure seemed to pause slightly, then let out a meaningful laugh:

"Interesting... truly interesting..." The voice no longer carried its previous air of supremacy, instead carrying a note of appreciation, "Chen Ji, you're more intriguing than I anticipated. No wonder the Tianji Record chose you.'

"But you think this mere courage can break the局?" The voice turned abruptly cold, "Naive!"

In an instant, boundless pressure came surging like a tide. Chen Ji felt a tightness in his chest, and the spiritual power within his body showed signs of losing control.

"This strike is a lesson for you." The voice was cold and authoritative, "If you dare again to presumptuously discuss breaking the局—"

Before the words even finished, a streak of black light descended from the depths of the heavens, heading directly toward Chen Ji and Chen Jie.

At this critical moment, Chen Jie swiftly positioned himself before Chen Ji, forming seals with both hands and channeling the power of the Heavenly Providence's Eye, forcibly taking the blow.

"Cough—" Chen Jie let out a muffled grunt, a thread of blood seeping from his mouth. Yet his stance remained immovable, shielding Chen Ji resolutely.

Chen Ji stared blankly at Chen Jie's back, his heart churning like tumultuous waves.

This person... just moments ago was persuading him to merge, yet now unhesitatingly blocked this lethal strike for him. Was this genuine feeling or merely pretense?

dialogue.content: "Don't overthink it." Chen Jie didn't turn around, his voice somewhat hoarse, "I simply refuse to let this game be ended before it's finished.'

text.content:
In the void, that vague figure seemed quite pleased with Chen Jie's display, letting out a low laugh:

"Indeed, you haven't disappointed me." The voice faded away, "Continue this game. I wish to see how far you two can go.'

As the words fell, that massive eye gradually dissolved, and with it the oppressive feeling vanished.

Only two figures remained in the void, facing each other from afar.

Chen Ji gazed at Chen Jie's bloodstained garments, his heart filled with mixed emotions. He parted his lips, wanting to speak, yet found himself at a loss for words.

dialogue.content: "Don't look at me that way." Chen Jie turned around, wiping the blood from the corner of his mouth, "I've said, we are not enemies—at least not for now.'
"How have you considered the matter of merging?" His gaze was deep and complex, "You must have sensed it—when that one struck just now, even the Heavenly Providence's Eye couldn't fully resist.'
"Separately, neither of us can match that one. Only through merging is there a sliver of hope.'

text.content:
Chen Ji did not answer immediately. He quietly regarded Chen Jie, his mind teeming with countless thoughts.

Merging... can it truly work? Or is this merely another, deeper trap?

dialogue.content: "I need time to consider." Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice calm yet resolute, "But regardless of the final decision—"
He stared at Chen Jie, his gaze burning intensely: 'I will remember today's matter.'

text.content: Chen Jie looked at Chen Ji, a faint smile slowly curling at the corner of his mouth. In that smile, there was even a rare hint of gentleness. 'Good.' He turned around, his back facing Chen Ji. 'Three days later, the same place. If you've made your decision, come see me.'

'Remember,' his figure began to fade away, but his voice clearly entered Chen Ji's ears, 'this chess game has entered its final stage. Whatever choice you make, be prepared—' 'Because the true decisive battle is about to begin.' The words fell, and Chen Jie's figure vanished completely into the Void.

Chen Ji stood alone in the Void, not moving for a long while. His mind kept replaying everything that happened today—Chen Jie's mockery, the proposal of fusion, the appearance of the Chess Player, and that final block. Too much information, too many variables, too many unexpected twists.

'Fusion...' Chen Ji murmured to himself, a complex light flickering in his eyes. He lowered his head to look at his own hands, then raised his gaze toward the sky that had already returned to calm. If fusion could truly break the chess game, then what was the price? If it couldn't, where should he go from here?

Just then, a familiar voice rang in his mind: 'Little one, you did well.' It was Mo Xiansheng's voice, aged yet gratified. 'To remain neither servile nor overbearing before the Chess Player—in that alone, you've surpassed all previous prophetic ones by far.'

dialogue.content: 'As for the matter of fusion...' Mo Xiansheng's voice turned meaningful. 'You don't need to rush into a decision now. Some answers need to be found by yourself.'

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head with a bitter smile. 'Elder, couldn't you give me a clear answer?'

dialogue.content: 'Haha, if this old man told you everything, wouldn't that make me another Chess Player?' Mo Xiansheng's laughter echoed in Chen Ji's mind. 'Remember, the true essence of the Tianji Record has never been about foresight—it's about—'
His words gradually faded, leaving only the final sentence: '—creating the future.'

text.content: Chen Ji stood frozen, savoring the meaning of these words. Creating the future... not predicting, not rewriting, but creating. So this was the true secret of the Tianji Record. He took a deep breath, and resolute light reignited in his eyes.

'Three days...' Chen Ji murmured quietly. 'That's enough.' He turned around and stepped out of the Void. The Sect Gate of Tianqing Sect loomed faintly in the distance, where there were unfinished matters he needed to complete, people he needed to protect, and mysteries yet to be solved. And three days later, he would face Chen Jie again, making one of the most important decisions of his life.

Just as he was about to leave the Void, an odd sensation suddenly surged in his heart. It was a feeling of being watched—not from Chen Jie, not from the Heavenly Eye, nor from the Chess Player just now. It was a gaze far deeper, more ancient, as if coming from the very source of destiny itself. Chen Ji's footsteps halted, and he turned sharply.

The Void was utterly silent, nothing was there. But Chen Ji was certain that gaze had truly existed. Those eyes were cold and profound, as if examining the most insignificant ants beneath heaven, yet also as if anticipating something. '...Who is it?' he asked quietly, his voice echoing in the vast Void. No one answered.

Chen Ji tightly clenched his fists, his fingernails almost piercing into his palms. From the moment he transmigrated to this world, he thought he was playing chess against Heaven, struggling against fate. But only today did he realize that above Heaven there were Chess Players, and above those Chess Players perhaps lay even more profound existences. How vast was this chess game?

'Whoever you are...' Chen Ji raised his head, fierce fighting spirit blazing in his eyes. 'Since you want to watch the show, I'll perform for you!' He swept his sleeves, his figure transforming into a stream of light, breaking through the Void and rushing toward Tianqing Sect. Behind him, that faint yet present gaze remained, like an invisible eye always locked onto his retreating figure.

Three days later, the Breaker and the Son of Destiny would meet again. And before that, Chen Ji had to unravel the mystery of fusion and find the path leading to true liberation. Because he knew his time was running out. Since the Chess Player had revealed himself, he would never give Chen Ji much breathing room. This round, he would stake everything.
